title: Clear space requirements

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Protect a mark from visual interference, because nearby elements can weaken recognition and obscure its boundaries.
strategic_value: A measurable isolation area can keep IBM’s 8-bar recognizable across third-party layouts.
demonstration: A left text column introduces the rule; a large gray panel shows the IBM logo inside an X-measured clear-space construction with a registration-mark callout.
practical_value: Measure the isolation zone from the I height and keep other content beyond it.

content_islands.name: Rule text
content_islands.spec: Place the clear-space heading and minimum-distance statement at upper left.

content_islands.name: Isolation construction
content_islands.spec: Center the large logo in the right field, with four surrounding X boxes and an explanation of the I-height unit.

content_islands.name: Registration callout
content_islands.spec: Place the registration note beside the small registered mark at the logo’s lower right.

ingredient.name: Third-party logo isolation
ingredient.role: Keep the trademark visually distinct from nearby content.
ingredient.application: Reserve clear space at least equal to the I height around the IBM mark.
ingredient.scope: This guide’s general third-party placement rule. The registration-mark instruction shown here has explicit clothing and small-item exceptions on page 13.

reference_purposes.Application: The diagram defines the clear-space unit as the height of the I and shows the surrounding isolation area.
reference_purposes.Constraint: This page requires clear space at least equal to trademark height and says the 8-bar includes the registration mark; page 13 separately supplies merchandise exceptions.
